sloka: सर्वाणि अनुचरिष्यामि यदि सीता हि लभ्यते ।एते महा मृगा वीर माम् ईक्षन्ते पुनः पुनः ॥३-६४-१५॥
transliteration: sarvāṇi anucariṣyāmi yadi sītā hi labhyate ।ete mahā mṛgā vīra mām īkṣante punaḥ punaḥ ॥3-64-15॥

translations.english: O mighty Lakshmana these deer are looking at me again and again indicating that they wish to tell me something.
